title: Sunset Fade
description: Brighten a light as the sun sets, then dim it off by night.
---

```{python}
#| include: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(next(p for p in Path.cwd().parents if (p / "great-docs.yml").exists()) / "docs"))
import _helpers as h
from ha_automations.apps import sunset_fade
S = sunset_fade.SunsetSettings
```

Brightens a light as the sun sets. Dims it after sunset, then turns it off at `off_time`.

## Use it

Add to `apps.yaml`:

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
h.usage_yaml(sunset_fade)
```

- Required: `light`.
- Runs: every evening.
- Test event: `<app name>_start`.

## Settings

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
h.settings_table(S)
```

Levels: sun elevation in degrees. See [Sun levels](sun-levels.qmd).

## What it does

| Sun | Light |
|---|---|
| Above `from_level` | Untouched |
| Reaches `from_level` | Starts at `min_brightness` |
| Between `from_level` and `to_level` | Brightens on the Sunrise Fade dim curve, reversed |
| Reaches `to_level` | Reaches `max_brightness` |
| Rising | Untouched |

| Time | Light |
|---|---|
| From `to_level` until `off_time` | Dims by clock time on the same curve, reversed |
| `off_time` | Fades off over `off_transition` seconds |

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Brightness against sun elevation, then clock time, default settings. Time runs left to right."
h.fade_chart(S)
```

## Examples

**Softer light**

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp
  max_brightness: 30
```

**Start later, finish darker** (room with good daylight)

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp
  from_level: 2
  to_level: -8
```

**Turn off when fully dark**

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp
  off_level: -18
```

**Turn off at midnight**

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp
  off_time: "00:00:00"
```

**Stay at full brightness until `off_time`**

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp
  dim: false
```

**Leave on all night**

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp
  off_time: null
```

**Two lights**

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp

hallway_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.hallway
  max_brightness: 20
```

## Test it

1. **Developer tools > Events**.
2. Event type: `<app name>_start`, e.g. `living_room_sunset_start`.
3. **Fire event**.

| When | Result |
|---|---|
| Dusk | Light updates |
| Morning | Log: `skip: sun rising` |
| Afternoon | Log: `skip: short of ramp_from` |
| Evening | Light dims |

## Notes

- Restart during the fade: carries on at the next sun update. A restart while dimming starts the dim again from that moment, holding the light until the curve falls below it.
- With `off_level`: turning the light back on afterwards lasts only until the next sun update, until about midnight.
- Manual changes: [Manual control](manual-control.qmd).
- Problems: [Light app troubleshooting](light-troubleshooting.qmd).
